name: carex
description: CareX white-label booking platform + autonomous engineering harness

scripts.test:all: npm run harness:test && npm run test
scripts.build:web: esbuild apps/web/src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=apps/web/public/app.js && esbuild apps/web/src/manage.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=apps/web/public/manage.js && esbuild apps/web/src/auth.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=apps/web/public/auth.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && npm run build:e2e && playwright test
scripts.prestart: node -e "try{require.resolve('@electric-sql/pglite');require.resolve('pg')}catch(e){console.error('Dependencies are missing or out of date. Run: npm install');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.start: npm run -s build:web && npm run -s build:api && node dist/main.mjs
